lines.1: There were still students out on the school grounds.
lines.2: Quite a few people remained, even this late in the day.
lines.3: Probably because the Ryuumei Festival was coming up.
lines.4: Yoshimi and I walked side by side.
lines.5: Even though we were dating, it was embarrassing to have other people see us together.
lines.6: 「You hang out with Date and the others at night too, right, Tsushima?」
lines.7: Yoshimi was the first to speak.
lines.10: 「I'm an only child, and now I've moved away from home and live alone, remember?」
lines.11: 「I guess I've always admired that sort of thing.」
lines.12: 「Where did that come from all of a sudden?」
lines.13: 「Ahaha. I was watching you and Date work together so happily today, and it got me thinking.」
lines.14: 「It must be wonderful to be that close all day and at night too.」
lines.15: 「You've got the Princess--Erika Kiriya as a friend.」
lines.16: 「You two have made up already, right?」
lines.20: Being a candidate to inherit the Kiriya Company couldn't be easy.
lines.21: 「If you'd like, come visit my place sometime.」
lines.24: 「If you're sure, I'd be happy to come whenever you want.」
lines.27: A sweet warmth spread through my heart until it almost tingled.
lines.28: 「Come to think of it, where do you live?」
lines.29: 「Keep going this way to the highway. I'm in apartment 602 in the building there.」
lines.30: 「Oh, the one at the foot of Dobu Hill? That's where you live?」
lines.31: 「You know where it is? I guess you really are a local.」
lines.33: 「Really? Then you can come over whenever you like.」
lines.40: 「Have you... written anything on your career survey yet?」
lines.41: 「Haha. I played it safe and put down college.」
lines.43: 「Ellie has invited me to work for the Kiriya Company, though.」
lines.44: 「Really? It may have a notorious reputation, but it's a world-famous, first-rate company. Sounds like a good opportunity.」
lines.46: 「But it wouldn't quite fulfill me. I guess I'm talking about emotionally.」
lines.50: 「So, as an only child, you picture a kind husband, cute children, maybe a dog, and one big warm family?」
lines.51: 「...That does sound nice. Yeah, a truly warm family.」
lines.52: 「Which means I'm currently accepting applications for a kind husband.」
lines.54: Yoshimi looked me in the eyes and smiled.
lines.55: My heart pounded in my chest.
lines.56: A sweet, aching feeling washed over me.
lines.57: Before I knew it, we had reached the fork where we parted ways.
lines.61: I couldn't just let a girl who had said something that adorable walk away.
lines.66: There was no one else around.
lines.70: Her lips were fuller than the Princess's, and softer for it.
lines.71: The fact that I even made that comparison might make me the worst.
lines.76: Both our faces turned bright red.
lines.79: 「If you'll have me, feel free to work me into your life plan.」
lines.83: 「Would you like to come over now?」
lines.85: 「Sorry. I've got a taste-testing shift at the curry place tonight...」
lines.87: 「Sorry. That was a lot to ask so suddenly.」
lines.90: 「We have all the time in the world.」
lines.94: Yoshimi kept waving vigorously until she was out of sight.
lines.95: I already wanted to talk to her again tomorrow.
lines.97: Did being an only child, living alone, and feeling lonely mean she wasn't happy now?
lines.98: I knew all too well how one worry after another kept weighing on her.
lines.100: I made that vow to the setting sun.
